output.explanation:
The central tree retains the persistence boundaries, commit ordering, publication flow and read dependencies while shrinking from 9,344 to 6,539 characters (30%) and from 134 to 87 lines (35%). Four peripheral trees expand validation, record encoding, catalog behavior and portable contexts. M = modular structure, C = call flow, O = ownership/lifetime, D = data dependency. Positions leave gaps between measured text bounds; edge lines are 1-based.

All details come from the supplied sources. Workspace lifecycle and transfer validation come from workspaceRecordStore.ts and workspaceRecords.ts; encoding and reconstruction come from canvasCheckpointRecords.ts; publication, cache invalidation and ownership migration come from canvasCatalogStore.ts; context portability comes from workspaceService.ts. New details include initialization/replacement behavior, transfer transaction checks, semantic record boundaries, WeakMap reuse, placement-lineage constraints, source-binding cache invalidation and interrupted UI normalization.

Corrections and qualifications: apply() validates batch shape before reading records, reversing the seed's stated order. MappingWorkspaceService calls an injected repository, and MappingDiagramService calls an injected capture capability; the supplied files do not establish their concrete adapter wiring to WorkspaceRecordStore. Workspace writes explicitly fsync files/directories, whereas DiagramRevisionStore.put has no fsync. Catalog writeJsonAtomic and DiagramPersistence implementations are not supplied, so their internal durability and restoration behavior remain unverified beyond visible calls and comments. The head-map shortcut belongs to selected-checkpoint loading; full restoration reconstructs references and checks the supplied head map. No garbage collection is shown in these inputs.

Durable Records and Publication
|-- [M] Persistence capabilities and boundaries
|   |-- DiagramStore: shared repository facade
|   |   |-- Exposes repositories, project initialization/loading and diagramPersistence
|   |   |-- projectCatalogs and canvases share one ProjectCatalogStore instance
|   |   `-- Constructs DiagramPersistence with a DiagramRevisionStore backend
|   |-- Editable workspace: MappingWorkspaceService -> MappingWorkspaceRepository
|   |   |-- Service exposes records, batches, view headers and import/export preparation
|   |   `-- WorkspaceRecordStore exposes state/load/replace/apply/viewHeaders/capture
|   |       `-- Manifest reads, cache, write queue and atomic writes stay private
|   `-- Published representations: MappingDiagramService -> projectCatalogs
|       |-- ProjectCatalogStore extends CanvasCatalogStore; adds corpus compactions
|       |-- CanvasCatalogStore depends on catalog rules and DiagramPersistence
|       `-- Catalog serialization and stored reads are private; saveRepresentationCatalog is public
|-- [O] Workspace: mutable manifest retains immutable record contents
|   |-- [D] State = manifest revision + records reached through content hashes
|   |   |-- Index: project, document IDs, active document and cross-canvas transfers
|   |   `-- Document: metadata/version, baseline, canvas, viewport and history records
|   |-- [C] WorkspaceRecordStore.apply(projectId, batch)
|   |   |-- Serialize through an in-process queue keyed by storage root
|   |   |-- Validate batch shape, then read current records
|   |   |-- Check persisted request receipt before expectedRevision
|   |   |   |-- Same request digest -> return recorded revision
|   |   |   `-- Different digest -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- New request requires expectedRevision == manifest revision
|   |   |   `-- Mismatch -> VERSION_CONFLICT; reload before saving
|   |   |-- Build candidate map; reject duplicate keys and immutable-content changes
|   |   |   `-- Validate documents, history references and cross-canvas transfers
|   |   `-- publish(candidate manifest, records, changed keys)
|   |       |-- Write changed JSON blobs under SHA-256 IDs; verify existing bytes
|   |       |-- Missing blob: temporary file -> fsync -> rename
|   |       |-- At most 8 writers; await every writer even when one fails
|   |       |-- fsync record directory before publishing references
|   |       `-- Replace manifest atomically, then fsync its directory
|   |           `-- References, new revision and request receipt become visible together
|   `-- Failure and lifetime
|       |-- Before manifest replacement: prior references remain; written blobs may remain
|       |-- After replacement: retry the same requestId to discover the persisted receipt
|       `-- Handles close and temporary files are removed; no blob GC appears here
|-- [C] Publish an already persisted checkpoint as a catalog revision
|   `-- MappingDiagramService.publishCheckpoint(input)
|       |-- Require project, publication method and injected capture capability
|       `-- CanvasCatalogStore.publishCheckpoint(projectId, input, capture callback)
|           |-- Parse input; enter this catalog instance's serialized queue
|           |-- Read stored catalog without restoring historical revisions
|           |-- Check requestId + input signature before invoking capture
|           |   `-- Matching retry returns prior receipt; mismatch -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|           |-- Existing target requires settled status + expectedRevisionId
|           |   `-- Reject an explicit change of repository ownership
|           |-- Invoke injected capture(project, document, checkpoint, expectedVersion)
|           |   `-- WorkspaceRecordStore supplies a matching capture API; wiring is not shown
|           |-- Build temporary one-checkpoint history -> document scene and edges
|           |-- Resolve repository ownership and validate it against the project
|           |-- catalog rules.publishMappingDiagram -> new representation revision
|           |-- Set revision content to capture.stored, retaining persisted archive references
|           `-- writeJsonAtomic(catalog + checkpoint receipt)
|               |-- Receipt: representation, revisionId, savedVersion and checkpointId
|               `-- Workspace commit and catalog publication are separate writes
|-- [O] Catalog retains published references and receipts
|   |-- General save: await DiagramPersistence.persist(catalog), then writeJsonAtomic
|   |   `-- Persistence completes before the catalog is replaced
|   |-- DiagramRevisionStore: public put/get; private record path resolution
|   |   |-- put: JSON -> SHA-256 -> byte equality check or temporary write + rename
|   |   |-- get: verify bytes against ID, then parse
|   |   `-- Supports diagram/revision/history and workspace records; no fsync here
|   |-- Group publication ends with one catalog replacement
|   |   |-- Output promotion: group membership + canvases + retry receipt
|   |   `-- Change acceptance: new heads + acceptance receipt
|   |-- Generated save without representationId: existing generated.key returns prior result
|   `-- Archive changes catalog metadata while preserving encoded history references
`-- [D] Read results depend on requested scope and referenced records
    |-- Reconstructed checkpoint: identity + path-to-item references + value/text items
    |   |-- Selected checkpoint uses head map, or replays base + record deltas
    |   |-- Delta depth bounded at 31; encoder starts a full base when needed
    |   `-- Equal serialized items share IDs; sourceAscii and long strings use text items
    |-- WorkspaceRecordStore.capture pins one manifest's record references
    |   |-- Require history.headId == checkpointId and metadata.version == expectedVersion
    |   |-- Hydrate selected checkpoint + only referenced diagram revisions
    |   `-- Return header/head/revisions/metadata and document-wide archive references
    |-- Saved-view headers: index + document metadata/history; no checkpoint bodies
    |-- Catalog reads
    |   |-- loadCurrentRepresentationCatalog -> requested/current histories only
    |   |-- loadRepresentationCatalog -> restore with requested history validation
    |   `-- Acceptance receipt listing reads stored catalog without restoration
    `-- Portable workspace transfer via MappingWorkspaceService
        |-- Export: context references + backing store -> inline snapshots
        `-- Import: inline snapshots -> context files -> bound references

Workspace record lifecycle and validation
|-- [C/O] Establish or replace the workspace
|   |-- state(): missing manifest -> legacy snapshot or empty records
|   |   `-- Publish revision 0 with no retry receipts
|   `-- replace(): absent manifest -> false; otherwise publish revision + 1
|       `-- Rebuild record references while retaining existing receipts
|-- [C] apply(): validate before publish
|   |-- requestId: 1-150 word/hyphen characters; revision: safe integer
|   |-- At most 100000 changes; each key at most 1000 characters
|   |-- Reject duplicate keys, mixed delete/value and unknown change fields
|   `-- Existing revision/item values cannot change
|       `-- Checkpoint re-encoding compares restored semantic state
|           `-- transactionId excluded; encoding/base may change
|-- [D] validateRecordUpdate(): document consistency
|   |-- At most 100 unique document IDs; active ID must be present
|   |-- No records belonging to removed canvases
|   |-- Each document needs metadata, baseline, history and canvas
|   |-- Canonical encoded IDs and item SHA-256 hashes are checked
|   `-- Validate affected histories and current presentation/composition
|       `-- Removing checkpoint/revision records requests full history validation
`-- [D] Transfer consistency spans both canvases
    |-- Unique transfer IDs; distinct source/destination must exist
    |-- Both before/after checkpoints must exist for both participants
    |-- Destination-after transactionId must match transfer ID
    `-- A move also requires source-after transactionId to match

Checkpoint and view record codec
|-- [D] CanvasValueEncoder splits at semantic record boundaries
|   |-- Scene root/children, edges, diagram contexts and bindings
|   |-- Display nodes, diagram views, control surfaces and selections
|   `-- Parent skeleton retains ordering with null placeholders
|       `-- Path arrays map to SHA-256 IDs of canvas-value items
|-- [O/D] Text separation and sharing
|   |-- sourceAscii or strings >= 512 characters -> canvas-text items
|   |-- canvas-value retains text paths and text IDs
|   `-- Equal JSON reuses IDs; takeItems() drains pending items
|-- [D] CanvasCheckpointEncoder stores bounded deltas
|   |-- Parent depth < 31 -> use parent refs as base; otherwise start at depth 0
|   |-- Diff contains added IDs, updated [old,new] pairs and removed IDs
|   |-- Reusing checkpoint ID requires same refs and parent; transactionId may vary
|   `-- Optional head record holds the complete current reference map
|-- [C/D] loadCanvasCheckpoint(): reconstruct one selected checkpoint
|   |-- Head map supplied -> skip base traversal
|   |-- Otherwise follow bases; reject cycles and invalid depth/base relationships
|   |-- Load distinct value items, then their text items; verify item hashes
|   `-- readCanvasRecords fills root and shorter paths before deeper paths
|       `-- Filling requires existing null placeholders
`-- [O] Reuse during workspace validation
    |-- restoreCanvasCheckpoints keeps a WeakMap keyed by checkpoint object
    |-- Reuse requires identical refs and dependency object identities
    `-- Full restore checks supplied head map against reconstructed refs

Catalog publication and read boundaries
|-- [C/O] Output promotion publishes a group
|   |-- requestId retry requires matching signature
|   |-- Validate canvas-project and repository membership
|   |-- Placement lineage requires bindings with matching promoted canvas IDs
|   |   `-- Record checkpoint and canvas-revision IDs in lineage
|   `-- Backfill lineage: same signature; an existing different lineage is rejected
|-- [C/O] Change acceptance publishes all new heads together
|   |-- Retry keyed by changeSessionId checks requestId and sessionVersion
|   |-- Require nonempty, distinct documents and unique existing targets
|   |-- Existing target: settled status and expectedRevisionId must match
|   `-- Fork proposal; existing target adopts proposal into its saved history
|       `-- Receipt records before/after revisions and proposed checkpoint
|-- [D/O] Source-binding reads share a cached Promise
|   |-- Key: project + catalog path/inode/size/mtime/ctime
|   |-- Atomic replacement changes file metadata, invalidating cached reads
|   |-- Read stored histories -> DiagramPersistence.sourceBindings
|   `-- Rejection clears matching entry; callers receive a structured clone
`-- [C/O] Catalog reads can migrate repository ownership
    |-- Read canvases/catalog.json, falling back to representations/catalog.json
    |-- Full read restores histories and normalizes canvas types
    |-- Missing ownership version + representations + project repositories
    |   `-- Infer missing repository IDs, set version 1, then persist catalog
    `-- archive(includeHistory=false) returns an empty revisions map

Portable contexts and interrupted UI state
|-- [C/D] MappingWorkspaceService.portableExport(input)
|   |-- Require initialized project and matching workspace projectId
|   |-- Visit live documents and every history snapshot
|   |-- Resolve context through loadDiagramAgentContext
|   |   `-- Apply context store's optional portable() transformation
|   `-- Return inline snapshot plus diagram/revision/fingerprint/hash metadata
|-- [C/O] MappingWorkspaceService.prepareImport(input)
|   |-- Require project and diagram context store
|   |-- Every context must carry a portable snapshot
|   |-- Store context files and return bound references
|   `-- Preparation returns a deserialized workspace; it does not save it
`-- [C/D] canvasViewChanges normalizes a cloned canvas before encoding
    |-- Conversation threads: clear progress and pending
    |   `-- Pending thread with context gets an interrupted-reply error
    |-- Generating control surface becomes error with retry guidance
    `-- Encoded view references share the document's item record namespace
